company: Panco Foods Inc. (DBA Pan's Mushroom Jerky)
category: savory snacks / meat-snack aisle (plant-based shiitake jerky)

facts.fact: 14 employees; Portland, OR; founded as Panco Foods Dec 2020 (brand launched 2018)
Sold in 2,500+ US stores; family shiitake recipe founder Michael Pan found visiting relatives in Malaysia in 2006
Shark Tank S12E6 (Nov 2020): Mark Cuban invested $300K for 18%; ~750 retail outlets at the time
Brand says it 'isn't trying to completely imitate beef'; no allergens to declare, gluten-free, vegan, Kosher
US plant-based meat retail sales fell 10% in dollars and 11% in units in 2025 to ~$1.0B
Meat snacks sales rose 11.3% to $6.4B in 2025 with volume +9.2%
Dried meat snacks $6.8B (+11.5%); jerky subcategory $2.4B (-0.5%); Chomps $797M (+61.5%)
H-E-B operates 455 stores in Texas and Mexico, ~$49.6B revenue (2025)
Mark Cuban announced Pan's selection for distribution in H-E-B stores across Texas
6 in 10 US households bought plant-based foods in 2025; distribution losses drove declines while velocities rose

problem_candidates.problem: Velocity gap: store count grew from ~750 (2020) to 2,500+ while revenue fell 12% from FY22 to FY24 annualized pace - each store is selling fewer bags
Category mis-association: shoppers file Pan's with 'plant-based meat' (-10% in 2025) instead of savory/protein snacks (+11.3%)
Unprofitable growth: net losses every year since FY22 mean the brand needs efficient, measurable trial, not expensive awareness

assumptions.text: Brand revenue per purchase ~$8.00: 2 bags at ~$4.00 wholesale (~50% of $7.99-8.99 shelf price); confirm with company
Gross margin ~42%: average of FY22 (40%), FY23 (30%), and YTD FY24 (57%) from SEC filing figures
H-E-B store-level baseline velocity unknown; measured week 0 via shelf audit + company sell-through data
Paid social: ~$2.30 CPM; 1.5% CTR on coupon creative; 12% coupon-claim-to-purchase (validate week 1)
Pan's and H-E-B would approve in-store demos and a digital coupon (proposed, not confirmed)
